name: Wonderfully Made
overview: Scripture reveals that every person is uniquely and intentionally created by God, fashioned in His own image and carefully formed even in the womb. The psalmist acknowledges God's intimate knowledge and involvement in our formation, describing us as 'fearfully and wonderfully made' with life given by the Spirit of the Almighty. Children are recognized as a precious heritage from the Lord, underscoring the divine value and purpose bestowed upon human life from conception onward.
